text:
ashley (People Ops): quick FYI about review form posting + how we handle late submissions — trying to make final process explicit so managers know what to do :wave:

ashley (People Ops): TL;DR: forms go live tomorrow 9am PT, auto-lock at close of business on Friday 11:59pm PT. If someone misses the deadline we have a staged clearance: up to 72h informal unlock, >72h needs an exception and may be excluded from calibration. details below.

mike (eng-manager): thanks — two quick Qs: 1) can managers submit on behalf of ICs? 2) what happens to self-assessments vs manager assessments if late?

ashley (People Ops): good q. 1) Managers can add manager-assessment entries for direct reports, but we cannot submit a self-assessment on behalf of an IC (auth/consent). if IC asks you to paste their self text into the form you can, but please mark it as "submitted by manager with employee consent" in the notes box.

ashley (People Ops): 2) both self and manager assessments are treated the same for cutoffs — each submission timestamp is the source of truth. however, for calibration we require manager assessments to be in at least 48h before the calibration window to be included. self-assessments submitted after the deadline won't block calibration but will be flagged and excluded from scoring if >72h late.

anika (manager): hmm ok — what about people who are on leave? e.g., extended PTO overlapping deadline. we have a couple in my org.

ashley (People Ops): for pre-approved leaves we will apply an "excused" status. Managers: please file a short exception request form (link below) with dates and attach approval evidence. People Ops will mark them excused and share guidance on how the manager should capture evidence/comments for the cycle.

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: review forms live tomorrow 09:00 PT — automated nudges at 24h and 6h before deadline.

mike (eng-manager): can we get the manager follow-up template you mentioned last meeting?

ashley (People Ops): yes — here's a short copy you can paste into Slack/email. use it to nudge folks 48/24/6 hours before the deadline.

ashley (People Ops): ```
Hi <@user> — friendly reminder: Performance review forms are due by Fri 11:59pm PT. Please complete your self-assessment here: https://redwood.reviews/FORM_ID. If you need help or need an extension, reply here or DM me by EOD Thu.
Thanks!
```

anika (manager): perfect, will use that. for unlock requests — how do we request unlocking and how long does unlocking take?

ashley (People Ops): process:
1) Manager pings People Ops thread with employee name + reason (copy the template we have).
2) People Ops reviews and will either approve a one-time manual unlock (usually within 4 business hours) for up to 72 hours, or ask for exec approval for >72h.
3) If approved, we unlock the specific user's form and set a "late submission" flag that is visible in the final export.

ashley (People Ops): exceptions that are typically approved: documented sick leave, last-minute medical emergency, official parental leave overlap. exceptions not typically approved: procrastination, missed calendar invite, laptop left at home.

julian (director): curious on calibration impact: if manager assessments come in late but self-assessments are present, will the calibrators still consider the late manager input?

ashley (People Ops): short answer: calibrators prefer completed manager assessments before the meeting. our guidance: any manager assessment submitted within 48h prior to calibration start will be included; anything submitted <48h will be included at the chair's discretion but will be highlighted as "late". Anything >72h after deadline is excluded from score aggregates unless explicit exception approved. we'll annotate the packet so chairs can decide.

mike (eng-manager): ok, so action items for managers: 1) use template reminders at 48/24/6h, 2) escalate extension requests to People Ops with evidence, 3) capture any employee-submitted text you paste on their behalf as "submitted with consent". anything else?

ashley (People Ops): add one more: 4) if you plan to rely on a proxy submission (e.g., manager-entered), cc people-ops in the thread so we have audit trail.

anika (manager): can people-ops send a consolidated list of late/unsubmitted folks 24h after deadline? useful for org-level follow-up.

people-ops-bot: Action logged: scheduled export -> "unsubmitted_report" at +24h post-deadline (recipients: @people-ops, @eng-managers).

ashley (People Ops): yes — we'll send an export at +24h, and another final "late-actions" export at +7 days summarizing who was excused vs unlocked vs required exec approval.

julian (director): sounds solid. one more ask: can we add a column to the export that indicates whether a late submission was included in calibration? that will help downstream reporting.

ashley (People Ops): yes — we'll add these fields to the CSV: "late_flag" (yes/no), "excused" (yes/no), "included_in_calibration" (yes/no), "unlock_requester" (manager email).

mike (eng-manager): thanks all. small nit: please confirm the timezone in the forms UI — near-EU folks have asked if deadlines show in local tz.

ashley (People Ops): forms show user's local timezone in the UI, but calendar invites / emails show PT. we will add a tooltip in the form tomorrow to clarify.

anika (manager): thanks — appreciate the clarity. i'll start sending reminders. :thumbsup:

ashley (People Ops): thanks everyone — if anything unexpected pops up DM me or open an exception request. I'll post the final FAQ in ##announcements after we go live. :rocket:
